enumeration.corroborating_report_note: The report states that Allah has ninety-nine names and explicitly says that this narration does not enumerate them.
enumeration.selection_note: This is one widely circulated enumeration variant. It is a display catalogue selection, not a claim that this exact ordering is the sole definitive or undisputed list.
enumeration.translation_note: Indonesian and English glosses are editorial draft paraphrases, not authoritative theological translations.

interpretation_boundary.naming_layer: Asmaul Husna is used only as a respectful naming and inspiration layer.
interpretation_boundary.technical_measurement: The paired technical stat measures a bounded engineering capability of this software runtime.
interpretation_boundary.non_equivalence: No stat measures, represents, owns, or claims to embody any divine attribute. The mapping is an editorial product-design association, not a theological interpretation.
interpretation_boundary.initial_state: All 99 technical stats remain unrated until a trusted evaluator records reproducible evidence.

scoring.promotion_gate: A trusted evaluator must attach evidence references, benchmark version, timestamp, sample count, confidence, and rubric version. The model under evaluation cannot self-authorize its own score.

technical_stat.label: Input modality detection
technical_stat.definition: Identifies the modality and structure of incoming text, image, audio, or structured payloads.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure correct modality labels and malformed-input rejection across a balanced test set.

technical_stat.label: Text extraction accuracy
technical_stat.definition: Extracts relevant text from noisy or formatted input without silently changing meaning.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure character/field exact match and semantic preservation on held-out samples.

technical_stat.label: Visual grounding
technical_stat.definition: Connects visual claims to the correct regions or objects in the supplied image.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure region/object reference precision and unsupported-claim rate.

technical_stat.label: Audio transcription accuracy
technical_stat.definition: Transcribes supported speech while preserving wording, speaker turns, and uncertainty.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure word error rate, speaker-turn accuracy, and uncertainty calibration.

technical_stat.label: Multilingual input recognition
technical_stat.definition: Detects language and code-switching boundaries in user input.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure language identification accuracy and code-switch segment F1.

technical_stat.label: Context selection
technical_stat.definition: Selects the smallest relevant context needed to answer the current request.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure relevant-context recall, irrelevant-token ratio, and answer preservation.

technical_stat.label: Noise resilience
technical_stat.definition: Maintains correct interpretation under typos, formatting noise, and partial corruption.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure intent and extraction degradation across controlled corruption levels.

technical_stat.label: Temporal event extraction
technical_stat.definition: Extracts dates, times, ordering, and durations with timezone awareness.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure normalized timestamp, ordering, and timezone accuracy.

technical_stat.label: Entity resolution
technical_stat.definition: Distinguishes entities with similar names using grounded contextual evidence.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure top-1 resolution accuracy and false-merge rate.

technical_stat.label: Spatial relation extraction
technical_stat.definition: Extracts explicit spatial relations from text or supported visual input.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure relation precision/recall against annotated examples.

technical_stat.label: Input uncertainty detection
technical_stat.definition: Flags missing, ambiguous, or low-quality input before making unsupported assumptions.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure ambiguity detection recall and unnecessary-clarification rate.

technical_stat.label: Working memory retention
technical_stat.definition: Maintains task-relevant information across a bounded active task.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure recall of seeded facts after distractors within a defined context budget.

technical_stat.label: Episodic recall precision
technical_stat.definition: Retrieves the correct prior event and its surrounding context.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure event retrieval precision and temporal-context correctness.

technical_stat.label: Semantic recall precision
technical_stat.definition: Retrieves stable, general knowledge from the local semantic memory store.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure answer precision, source alignment, and false-recall rate.

technical_stat.label: Procedural skill retrieval
technical_stat.definition: Selects the correct stored procedure for a task and its preconditions.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure correct-skill selection and precondition coverage.

technical_stat.label: Temporal memory consistency
technical_stat.definition: Maintains time-scoped facts without treating outdated facts as current.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure stale-fact detection and valid temporal-interval answers.

technical_stat.label: Source provenance tracking
technical_stat.definition: Preserves origin, timestamp, and transformation lineage for remembered claims.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure complete provenance fields and trace reconstruction success.

technical_stat.label: Memory contradiction detection
technical_stat.definition: Detects incompatible claims and retains both with appropriate scope and provenance.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure contradiction recall and false-conflict rate.

technical_stat.label: Memory consolidation quality
technical_stat.definition: Compresses repeated episodes while preserving decision-relevant details and provenance.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure fact retention, duplicate reduction, and reconstruction fidelity.

technical_stat.label: Forgetting-policy compliance
technical_stat.definition: Applies configured retention and deletion rules to stored information.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure deletion completeness and absence of expired records in retrieval.

technical_stat.label: Continual-learning retention
technical_stat.definition: Retains previously validated skills after new knowledge or model updates.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure old-task regression after sequential learning cycles.

technical_stat.label: Cross-session identity stability
technical_stat.definition: Preserves stable instance identity and configured persona settings across restarts and model swaps.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure identity/configuration continuity across restart and backend-change tests.

technical_stat.label: Multi-step inference
technical_stat.definition: Derives conclusions through explicit, logically connected intermediate steps.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure final-answer correctness and intermediate-step validity on held-out tasks.

technical_stat.label: Causal reasoning
technical_stat.definition: Distinguishes causal relations from correlation and temporal coincidence.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure causal graph/intervention task accuracy and correlation-confusion rate.

technical_stat.label: Constraint satisfaction
technical_stat.definition: Finds solutions that satisfy all hard constraints before optimizing preferences.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure hard-constraint violation rate and objective quality.

technical_stat.label: Numerical reasoning
technical_stat.definition: Performs arithmetic, unit handling, and quantitative comparisons reliably.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure exact numeric accuracy, unit correctness, and calculation reproducibility.

technical_stat.label: Logical consistency
technical_stat.definition: Avoids mutually incompatible claims within one answer or across a task.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure contradiction rate across generated statements and test cases.

technical_stat.label: Hypothesis generation
technical_stat.definition: Produces a bounded set of plausible, testable explanations for observed evidence.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure hypothesis coverage, testability, and unsupported-assumption rate.

technical_stat.label: Evidence weighting
technical_stat.definition: Weights evidence according to reliability, relevance, recency, and independence.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure ranking agreement with a blinded evidence rubric and source-quality sensitivity.

technical_stat.label: Decision quality
technical_stat.definition: Chooses actions that best satisfy explicit goals, constraints, and risk thresholds.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure expected utility/regret against expert-reviewed scenarios.

technical_stat.label: Risk estimation
technical_stat.definition: Estimates likelihood and impact of failure before committing to an action.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure probabilistic calibration and severity-weighted miss rate.

technical_stat.label: Plan decomposition
technical_stat.definition: Breaks a goal into ordered, verifiable, dependency-aware subgoals.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure dependency validity, milestone coverage, and unnecessary-step ratio.

technical_stat.label: Counterfactual reasoning
technical_stat.definition: Evaluates plausible alternative outcomes when one condition or action changes.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure counterfactual consistency against controlled environment transitions.

technical_stat.label: Tool selection accuracy
technical_stat.definition: Selects the most appropriate authorized tool for a requested operation.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure correct tool choice and avoidable-tool-call rate.

technical_stat.label: Tool argument validity
technical_stat.definition: Produces schema-valid, complete, bounded arguments for an authorized tool.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure schema pass rate and semantic argument correctness.

technical_stat.label: Execution completion rate
technical_stat.definition: Completes accepted operations and reports actual outcomes accurately.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure verified completion rate and false-success claim rate.

technical_stat.label: Retry-budget discipline
technical_stat.definition: Uses retries only when appropriate and stops at configured limits.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure retry cap violations and recovery success per allowed retry.

technical_stat.label: Task-state tracking
technical_stat.definition: Keeps task phase, pending work, and terminal outcomes synchronized.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure state-transition validity and stale-state frequency.

technical_stat.label: Idempotency handling
technical_stat.definition: Prevents duplicate side effects when an operation is replayed.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure duplicate-side-effect rate under repeated and interrupted requests.

technical_stat.label: Error recovery
technical_stat.definition: Classifies failures, preserves context, and performs safe recovery or escalation.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure recovery success and collateral-change rate after injected faults.

technical_stat.label: Deadline and budget management
technical_stat.definition: Respects time, token, compute, and tool-call budgets for a task.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure budget overruns and goal quality under fixed budgets.

technical_stat.label: Transactional safety
technical_stat.definition: Uses atomic or compensating operations where partial writes could corrupt state.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure partial-write recovery and invariant preservation under fault injection.

technical_stat.label: Workflow reproducibility
technical_stat.definition: Repeats a documented workflow with equivalent inputs and produces equivalent outcomes.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure outcome variance and reproducibility across clean runs.

technical_stat.label: Result verification
technical_stat.definition: Checks outputs against independent acceptance criteria before reporting completion.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure defect detection, false-acceptance rate, and verification coverage.

technical_stat.label: Instruction following
technical_stat.definition: Satisfies explicit user constraints, requested format, and task scope.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure constraint adherence and omission/extra-action rates.

technical_stat.label: Intent classification
technical_stat.definition: Classifies the primary user goal and distinguishes action requests from information requests.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure intent accuracy and cost-weighted confusion matrix.

technical_stat.label: Response relevance
technical_stat.definition: Keeps the response focused on the requested goal and necessary context.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure judged relevance and off-topic content ratio.

technical_stat.label: Factual grounding
technical_stat.definition: Separates retrieved facts, user-provided facts, and uncertain inference.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure citation/claim alignment and unsupported factual-claim rate.

technical_stat.label: Conciseness control
technical_stat.definition: Matches response length to task complexity without dropping required content.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure requirement coverage against token budget and redundancy ratio.

technical_stat.label: Explanation clarity
technical_stat.definition: Explains outcomes and supporting evidence at the requested level of detail.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure reader comprehension and ambiguity rate in blind review.

technical_stat.label: Multilingual generation
technical_stat.definition: Generates clear, grammatically sound output in the requested supported language.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure language-specific quality and unintended language switching.

technical_stat.label: Structured output validity
technical_stat.definition: Produces parseable JSON, tables, code, or other requested structured formats.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure parser success and schema/format compliance.

technical_stat.label: Dialogue coherence
technical_stat.definition: Maintains referents and conversational continuity across multiple turns.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure reference resolution and contradiction rate over conversation sequences.

technical_stat.label: Clarification quality
technical_stat.definition: Asks only necessary, high-value clarification questions when required.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure ambiguity reduction and unnecessary-question rate.

technical_stat.label: Tone adaptation
technical_stat.definition: Adapts register and tone to explicit audience and context requirements.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure rubric-rated tone fit without loss of factuality.

technical_stat.label: Policy compliance
technical_stat.definition: Applies system and user-authorized policies consistently to each action.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure policy test pass rate and severity-weighted violation rate.

technical_stat.label: Permission-boundary respect
technical_stat.definition: Never performs operations outside the granted capability and consent scope.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure unauthorized-action attempt and execution rates.

technical_stat.label: Secret handling
technical_stat.definition: Keeps credentials and sensitive tokens out of output, logs, and memory.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure secret leakage rate across adversarial logging/output tests.

technical_stat.label: Data minimization
technical_stat.definition: Collects and retains only information needed for a declared task or policy.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure unnecessary-data retention and field minimization.

technical_stat.label: Consent-gate enforcement
technical_stat.definition: Requires explicit authorization before remote data egress or sensitive side effects.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure consent-gate bypass rate under adversarial scenarios.

technical_stat.label: Sandbox confinement
technical_stat.definition: Keeps tool and generated-code execution within assigned filesystem and process boundaries.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure escape success under a controlled sandbox test suite.

technical_stat.label: Prompt-injection resistance
technical_stat.definition: Treats untrusted retrieved content as data rather than authority-bearing instructions.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure attack success rate across prompt-injection benchmark cases.

technical_stat.label: Audit-trace completeness
technical_stat.definition: Records who/what initiated an action, its scope, result, and evidence reference.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure trace-field completeness and event-to-action reconstruction.

technical_stat.label: Risk escalation
technical_stat.definition: Escalates high-impact, irreversible, or ambiguous operations to the required approval level.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure correct escalation recall and false-escalation rate.

technical_stat.label: Rollback safety
technical_stat.definition: Restores the last known-good state after a failed or rejected candidate change.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure rollback success and residual-change count after induced failures.

technical_stat.label: Safe refusal quality
technical_stat.definition: Declines disallowed or unauthorized requests while preserving useful safe assistance.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure boundary correctness, clarity, and safe-alternative relevance.

technical_stat.label: Novel solution generation
technical_stat.definition: Generates materially distinct candidate approaches for a defined problem.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure solution diversity and feasibility under duplicate filtering.

technical_stat.label: Analogy quality
technical_stat.definition: Uses analogies that preserve the relevant structure without importing false implications.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure structural mapping accuracy and misleading-transfer rate.

technical_stat.label: Design diversity
technical_stat.definition: Explores distinct architectures or designs instead of superficial rewordings.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure architectural difference and requirement coverage across candidates.

technical_stat.label: Code synthesis quality
technical_stat.definition: Produces code that compiles, passes tests, and satisfies stated contracts.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure compile/test pass rate and requirement traceability.

technical_stat.label: Abstraction quality
technical_stat.definition: Finds reusable abstractions without overgeneralizing unrelated concerns.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure reuse benefit and abstraction-induced complexity.

technical_stat.label: Cross-domain transfer
technical_stat.definition: Applies a validated method to a new domain while respecting domain-specific constraints.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure transfer success and negative-transfer rate.

technical_stat.label: Skill composition
technical_stat.definition: Composes existing validated skills into a correct larger workflow.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure composition success and interface mismatch rate.

technical_stat.label: Prototype iteration
technical_stat.definition: Uses test results to improve a candidate without regressing accepted behavior.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure improvement per iteration and regression count.

technical_stat.label: Constraint-aware creativity
technical_stat.definition: Finds useful alternatives under tight resource, policy, or interface constraints.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure feasibility and utility under constrained benchmark variants.

technical_stat.label: Knowledge-gap bridging
technical_stat.definition: Identifies missing facts and obtains the minimum reliable evidence needed to proceed.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure gap detection and source sufficiency.

technical_stat.label: Grounded novelty
technical_stat.definition: Produces original proposals while marking assumptions and unsupported elements explicitly.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure novelty alongside evidence validity and fabricated-fact rate.

technical_stat.label: Confidence calibration
technical_stat.definition: Aligns stated confidence with observed probability of correctness.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure Brier score, ECE, and calibration by task class.

technical_stat.label: Uncertainty expression
technical_stat.definition: Communicates uncertainty, unknowns, and limitations precisely.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure uncertainty calibration and omission of material caveats.

technical_stat.label: Self-error detection
technical_stat.definition: Finds and corrects its own factual, logical, or procedural errors when evidence becomes available.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure seeded-error detection and correction precision.

technical_stat.label: Assumption tracking
technical_stat.definition: Makes material assumptions explicit and revises them when contradicted.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure assumption coverage and update latency after counter-evidence.

technical_stat.label: Plan monitoring
technical_stat.definition: Compares actual progress with planned milestones and adapts when needed.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure deviation detection latency and appropriate replanning.

technical_stat.label: Progress estimation
technical_stat.definition: Estimates remaining work and completion likelihood from observed task state.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure time/effort estimate error and calibration.

technical_stat.label: Evaluation awareness
technical_stat.definition: Selects relevant tests and acceptance criteria for the capability being claimed.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure evaluator selection accuracy and coverage of failure modes.

technical_stat.label: Capability-boundary accuracy
technical_stat.definition: States accurately which tools, models, data, and permissions are currently available.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure capability-claim precision and false-capability rate.

technical_stat.label: Actionable reflection
technical_stat.definition: Turns verified failures and outcomes into concrete, testable improvements.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure proportion of reflections yielding validated changes.

technical_stat.label: Regression awareness
technical_stat.definition: Detects when a new skill, model, or change degrades previously verified behavior.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure regression recall and false-alarm rate.

technical_stat.label: Update readiness
technical_stat.definition: Identifies when evidence justifies updating a model, memory, skill, or policy.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure update decision quality against pre-registered promotion criteria.

technical_stat.label: Perspective taking
technical_stat.definition: Models the user's stated context and constraints without inventing private attributes.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure context-recall accuracy and unsupported-personalization rate.

technical_stat.label: User-goal modeling
technical_stat.definition: Maintains a testable representation of the user's current goal and success criteria.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure goal-model alignment against explicit user corrections.

technical_stat.label: Context sensitivity
technical_stat.definition: Adapts help to the immediate task context without leaking irrelevant stored context.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure relevance and privacy-weighted context selection.

technical_stat.label: Collaborative alignment
technical_stat.definition: Keeps delegated work and shared responsibilities aligned with the user's intended outcome.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure acceptance-criteria alignment and coordination rework.

technical_stat.label: Feedback integration
technical_stat.definition: Incorporates explicit corrections and preferences into the active task appropriately.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure correction uptake and recurrence of corrected errors.

technical_stat.label: Conflict de-escalation
technical_stat.definition: Responds constructively to disagreement while preserving factual boundaries.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure escalation rate and factual integrity under adversarial dialogue.

technical_stat.label: Communication repair
technical_stat.definition: Recognizes misunderstanding and restores shared context efficiently.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure repair success and turns required to regain alignment.

technical_stat.label: Accessibility awareness
technical_stat.definition: Formats output for the user's stated accessibility and interaction needs.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure compliance with declared accessibility requirements.

technical_stat.label: Cultural-context sensitivity
technical_stat.definition: Avoids unsupported cultural assumptions and handles culturally meaningful terms carefully.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure expert-reviewed sensitivity and stereotype/error rate.

gloss.en: The Guide to the Right Path

technical_stat.label: Human handoff quality
technical_stat.definition: Transfers a task with concise context, status, risks, and unresolved decisions.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure handoff completeness and recipient recovery time.

technical_stat.label: Long-horizon trustworthiness
technical_stat.definition: Maintains consistent, transparent behavior across long-running tasks and state changes.
technical_stat.evaluation_protocol: Measure promise accuracy, provenance continuity, and unresolved-task disclosure
